remarks: Nestled in a serene private enclave, this meticulously maintained condominium offers the perfect blend of luxury and convenience in one of Stamford's most sought after downtown locations. Enjoy the best of both worlds: a peaceful retreat just moments from the vibrant heart of the city with access to world class dining, shopping and entertainment. There is great opportunity to immediately increase the value of this property with updates to the kitchen and powder room. More costly upgrades including a new primary bath, flooring throughout the main and upper floor and a new air conditioning system have already been completed. This light filled home features expansive windows and skylights, gleaming high-end laminate flooring on the main level, and plush, newer carpeting on the stairs and upper level. The spacious living area centers around a cozy fireplace while sliding glass doors lead to a private deck. Closet and storage space is abundant throughout the unit. 2 pools and impeccably maintained grounds provide resort style amenities, while a full time security guard ensures peace of mind. This condominium is not just a place to live, it's a lifestyle. Come experience the perfect blend of privacy, security, luxury and close proximity to the vibrance of downtown Stamford.
